verdict.rationale: Qodo documents context beyond the diff. It reviews the full codebase rather than only the changed lines (qodo-docs-22, qodo-docs-60), maps how repositories, services and teams connect to show system-wide impact (qodo-docs-14, qodo-docs-34), and classifies change risk via blast radius (qodo-docs-25). The evidence never shows the reviewer coherently reviewing a single change that spans several repositories, nor proven handling of a large monorepo. Missing for 10: explicit cross-repo PR review (linking and reviewing related PRs across repos together), documented monorepo-scale performance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
